subject.title: fix(zai): add User-Agent header to endpoint detection probe

question: Should this z.ai-only PR wait for live Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof, or may maintainers waive that proof gap because the source fix is narrow and the linked issue has live before-fix header evidence?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not a code repair; it is whether mock-server proof plus reporter live output is enough without maintainer-held z.ai Coding Plan credentials, and which same-root PR should be canonical.

options.title: Require live proof or waiver
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until a contributor or maintainer posts redacted live Coding Plan endpoint-detection output, or a maintainer explicitly waives that proof gap.

options.title: Accept mock proof
options.body: Treat the local mock-server transcript plus the canonical issue's live before-fix output as sufficient and continue normal merge review.

options.title: Choose another candidate
options.body: Land a different narrow sibling PR for the same issue and close this PR as superseded after that merge.

recommendation.title: Require live proof or waiver
recommendation.body: Keep this PR blocked until a contributor or maintainer posts redacted live Coding Plan endpoint-detection output, or a maintainer explicitly waives that proof gap.
